The '''2003–04 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 68th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 23 August 2003 and ended on 22 May 2004. [[Panathinaikos F.C.|Panathinaikos]] won their 19th Greek title and their first one in eight years.
